messages.subject: mark_area issue with shiny + ggvis?
parts:
Hello all,

I'm having trouble finding the problem with my fairly simple shiny app. Source can be found here -- https://gist.github.com/cpsievert/8838380

The area isn't plotted correctly when you move the slider to a positive value, say 1.5. The strange thing is that if I enter the following in my RStudio console, the area is plotted properly in the preview window:

library(ggvis)
x <- seq(-4, 4, .1)
dat <- data.frame(x, y=dnorm(x))
dat2 <- subset(dat, x <= 1.5)
ggvis(dat, props(x = ~x, y = ~y), mark_path()) + 
  mark_area(data=dat2, props(x = ~x, y = ~y, y2 := 360))

Thanks,

-Carson
